title: kumarsurv
text: Companion R package : Ospina, R., Pimentel, J. S. Cribari-Neto, F. Copula-Based Kumaraswamy Regression Anomaly Detection Doubly Bounded Time Series (manuscript submitted publication). marginal regression model time series unit interval, Kumaraswamy marginal distribution parametrized directly quantile prescribed level serial dependence induced Gaussian copula ARMA structure. Anomaly detection combines bootstrap-calibrated goodness--fit tests, one-step prediction bands cumulative sum (CUSUM) chart calibrated -control average run length. Applied weekly acute diarrheal disease incidence Platina, SP (Brazil). Site: https://raydonal.github.io/kumarsurv/

title: kumarsurv
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("Raydonal/kumarsurv")

title: kumarsurv
text: tau median, use fit_copula_multi_tau() instead bare fit_copula() call: likelihood surface can one interior stationary point given tau, fit_copula_multi_tau() runs monotonicity/invariance diagnostic paper’s Section 6.3 Table 3 rely pick right one. See vignette("reproducing--paper").
code: library(kumarsurv) data(platina)  X <- cbind(1, platina$trend, platina$sin, platina$cos) Z <- cbind(1, platina$trend, platina$sin, platina$cos) y <- platina$incidence y[y == 0] <- 1e-7  # boundary replacement, see the paper's Section 6.1  fit <- fit_copula(y, X, Z, p = 1, q = 1, family = "kuma", tau = 0.5) r <- qresiduals(fit)$r  # predictive quantile residuals

title: Fit the model at several quantile levels, with a monotonicity/invariance check — fit_copula_multi_tau
text: Log-likelihood invariance. tau-reparametrization describes distribution family every tau; parametrization changes, model. correct convergence, maximized log-likelihood therefore (approximately) across levels. fit whose log-likelihood departs others tol_ll found global maximum. Quantile monotonicity. mu_t^{(tau)}, conditional tau-quantile, must non-decreasing tau every t, definition quantile. catches spurious optima invariance check alone can miss (likelihood surface can nearly flat near spurious optimum). Fits flagged either check retried parameter estimates already-accepted level (nearest one, since spurious basin can reached several "reasonable" starting points), keeping restart highest log-likelihood among restore monotonicity levels already accepted. function cascade restarts : earlier investigation found restart cascade can converge degenerate region parameter space , despite nominally higher log-likelihood, violates invariance property (unambiguous sign spurious local optimum) – instead, unresolved cases flagged manual inspection.
